section.sectionSummaryBrief: To build Malchus, one must draw from a place beyond even the existence of souls, raising the question of how souls can reach such a level.
section.t: in order to effect that there be a building of Malchus, it is necessary to draw from a place where there is no
(not only the existence of the worlds,
And it is necessary to understand,
how is it possible that souls, through their service, will reach a place that is above their existence.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The explanation is that the absence of place for souls during the removal of Malchus relates to their existence, while the request "Make Me King" stems from the inner self-nullification of the soul's essence rooted in Atzmus.
section.t: And the point of the explanation in this is,
that this, that at the time of the removal of Malchus
there is seemingly no place for souls and their service
(for souls and Malchus are one matter),
is regarding the existence of souls,
and the matter of "Make Me King"
(that Yisrael request and beseech the Holy One, blessed be He, that He be King)
is the inner self-nullification that stems from the essence of the soul,
which is rooted in the Awtsmoos.
And when the essence of the soul is revealed, it draws down the Awtsmoos.
And through this, the building of Malchus is also effected.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The building of Malchus through drawing down Atzmus via the soul's essence is explained by the concept that Yisrael arose in thought, which is a self-thought, and they are above the thought of creation, as the consultation was with them in the second mode of self-thought. 7) And the explanation of the matter of the building of Malchus that is effected through the drawing down of the Awtsmoos, which comes through the revelation of the essence of the soul, it can be said, based on what is explained in many places regarding the matter of "Yisrael arose in thought", that this thought is a self-thought. For thought in general is outside the thinker [And like a person who thinks about some thing, the thought about the thing is below the person himself, and consequently it is like something external to him], but the thought of Yisrael is one with the thinker Himself. And this is the meaning of "Whom did He consult? The souls of the righteous" (and "Your people are all righteous"), that the consultation of "Whom did He consult" was not only regarding the creation of the worlds (whether to create worlds or not to create), but also regarding the thought of the coming into being of the worlds (whether there would be the thought of the coming into being of the worlds or not), from which it is understood, that the souls of Yisrael (with whom He consulted whether there would be the thought of the creation of the worlds) are above this thought. For the thought of the creation of the worlds, even as it is in the most elevated level, is analogous to a person thinking about some thing (a thought to create worlds), where the thought is external to him, but Yisrael arose in self-thought. And it is explained there, that the reason for this, that the consultation regarding the thought of the creation of the worlds was with Yisrael who arose in self-thought (even though self-thought is above the thought of the creation of the worlds), is, because in self-thought there are two modes. One thinks about oneself, and one thinks about something separate from him, and nevertheless the thought is not external to him because he himself is the thinker. And this that Yisrael arose in thought is the second mode of self-thought, that the Awtsmoos, so to speak, thinks about something other [And this is "You are children to Hashem your G-d", for since the root of the souls is in self-thought, that the Awtsmoos, so to speak, thinks about something other, therefore, even after they come into a drawing down, they are like children, for in a child (analogous to) the two aforementioned matters. The child is separate from the father and nevertheless has within him from the father's very essence]. And therefore the consultation regarding the thought of the worlds was with Yisrael. For the purpose of the creation of the world [that the lower ones be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He] is completed through the souls.
